facts.fact: Ascend Foods is a B2B quick-commerce company serving grocery products to retailers and kirana stores in Gurgaon.
Retailers can order products through the Ascend Foods app and receive them within 4 hours.
Ordering as needed can help retailers save shelf space and reduce money blocked in excess inventory.
The savings can be reinvested to grow the retail business and improve the retailer's quality of life.
